Item 1 on a scratch copy of sai/ with a fake HOME: `npm ci` exit 0; `npm run check` exit 0, 115 tests, skipped 0, todo 0; the fake HOME holds only .npm, no .sai-pixel-office. With the planned eslint block added to the copy ({files:["src/pixel-office/public/**/*.js"], languageOptions:{globals:{...globals.browser}}}) plus dummy files: eslint passes for `document` inside public/ and fails for it elsewhere; step 6 and step 7 hashes unchanged (adding public/ to step 7 would change it, which is why it excludes public/); item 8 grep exit 1; prettier --check passes. The design also reads eslint.config.js (RELEASE-VALIDATOR) as H1 asked. FINDINGS (design section; severity; concrete fix) C1 [BLOCKING] §4.6, §2.3 (App), §3.4, §8.3 E26, §10.2 PG-13/PG-14; criterion 7, Q10. The page poll protocol is incomplete in three ways the design never states. (a) No per-request timeout: a suspended server (for example the owner presses Ctrl+Z in the terminal) still accepts the TCP connection but never answers (I verified: curl connect 0.0002 s, then no reply until its 3 s limit, exit 28; it answers again after SIGCONT), so fetch never fails, «Нет связи с сервером Pixel Office» never appears and the stale page looks live. Criterion 10 already treats 'принял соединение и не отвечает' as a failure case for the hook. (b) setInterval every 2 s with no 'one request in flight' rule: slow responses overlap. (c) §4.6/§3.4 say 'from = 0 - заменить массив, иначе дописать' but never require from === entries.length, so a duplicated, reordered or skipped response silently shifts indices, and every rule is index-based (§4.2 order, D5 journal_lines, the §3.5 invariant 'номер элемента = номер строки'). Fix: in §4.6 and the App contract add: one request in flight (skip the tick while one is pending); a 3 s timeout (AbortController) counted as a failure; apply a response only if from === 0 (replace) or from === entries.length (append), otherwise discard it and re-poll with after = entries.length; poll at once on visibilitychange to visible (browsers throttle hidden-tab timers; this closes open question 13 in practice). Add tests PG-14b (fetch never settles: message after the timeout, no second request while one is pending, polling resumes), PG-14c (a response with wrong from is ignored, no duplicates), PG-14d (visibility). C2 [BLOCKING until ORCH decides; RULING ON OPEN QUESTION 2] §4.2 (the box and the last bullet of 'Строка основной сессии'), §3.5 (MainRow.closed_by 'server_start'), §9.4 README limitation 7, §10.2 PG-12d6, §12 D9, §13 Q2. Criterion 6(г) gives two closing events for an unterminated row: 'при следующем запросе той же сессии или при событии окончания сессии после её начала'. Closing it at a server start is a third trigger the text does not contain and it changes a case the text implies (UserPromptSubmit, then a server restart, then silence: 'в работе' by 6(г), 'окончание не записано' by the design). It is not compatible with the letter of 6(г); a design may not extend a validated criterion. Required: either (A) remove it - the 'ничего из этого нет -> server_start' bullet, the closed_by value, 'или запуском сервера' in README item 7 (which must then say the row stays «обрабатывает запрос» until the next prompt or SessionEnd), PG-12d6 shrunk to the cases without it, D9 and Q2 deleted - or (B) ORCH has REQ-ANALYST add 'или при запуске сервера после её начала' to 6(г) and REQ-VALIDATOR re-validates, and the design then cites the amended text. On the merits (B) is the better product (same reason as 6(в); avoids a stale 'обрабатывает запрос' after any server stop and restart), but that is ORCH's call and the design cannot carry it ahead of the text. If no decision is made, (A). C3 [BLOCKING until ORCH decides; RULING ON OPEN QUESTION 1] §10.1, §13.1, §14. REQ-001 'Что меняется' says tests are 'только новые файлы tools/test/pixel-office-*.test.js' and calls the list 'полный список записи'; REQ-007 names two files. tools/test/pixel-office-helpers.js is in neither. Ruling: the requirement needs an amendment (REQ-ANALYST, then REQ-VALIDATOR). The file stays: it is genuinely shared by six test files (fake DOM built from index.html, hook runner, event and journal builders) and duplicating it six times invites divergence. Renaming it to *.test.js is wrong: tools/package.json runs `node --test "test/**/*.test.js"` (I read it), so it would run as a test and every importing test file would re-run its tests. Dropping the file (six copies) is the fallback only if ORCH refuses the amendment. Checked: the designer's statement that node --test ignores the file is true because of that glob; `eslint .` and `prettier --check .` cover it; the criterion 14 greps over tools/test and snapshot-diff (tools/test/ is declared for PO-20260930-01) cover it, so no machine check is weakened. Suggested wording: REQ-001 '... и один общий файл помощников tools/test/pixel-office-helpers.js (без .test.js; прежние тесты и tools/test/helpers.js не меняются)'; REQ-007: add the same file to its list. After the amendment the block hashes in §0 and §11 change and must be restated. C4 [MEDIUM] §3.5, §4.7, §10.2 (PG-11, PG-12d, PG-16). Names used but not defined. (a) MainRow.key appears in the shape and drives data-key but is never defined (Task.key = agent_id); define it, for example 'main:' + start_index. (b) The journal row {index, time, event, role, description, ...} does not say where role and description come from per event kind (agent_type or subagent_type on PostToolUse, empty for session events); the tests that look for a hostile agent_type or description on the page need this. Add a small table event kind -> role/description. C5 [MEDIUM-LOW] §3.4, §4.2(в), §3.1, §9.4. journal_lines goes stale if the owner deletes or truncates events.jsonl and leaves server-starts.jsonl (README names five files and never says to remove them together): every later task has an index below the old journal_lines and shows «окончание не записано» until the journal grows past it. Fix: ignore a ServerStart whose journal_lines is greater than `lines` of the same response (it cannot be valid), say in README to delete both files together, add PG-12c7. C6 [LOW] §8.2, §10.2 SV-10/SV-11. The busy-port path (§9.1 step 4 probes the occupant with a 1 s GET) is tested with one occupant. Q10 asks for a failure test per external call; add occupants: silent socket (probe times out -> message, code 1), non-JSON HTTP, JSON without app, closes before replying. C7 [LOW] §5.2, §8, §10.2. JournalReadError -> 500 {"error":"read_failed"} has no test (SV-35 substitutes a throwing journal.read, SV-41 deletes the directory); add an unreadable events.jsonl (chmod 0000 or a directory): GET 500, server alive. State what starts() does on an OS read error (AP-014 class rule; the table says 'no errors'). C8 [LOW] §2.2 protocol.js. Say that the HMAC key is the 43-character secret string as UTF-8 (not base64-decoded) and the signature is lowercase hex; add one fixed known-answer vector (fictional secret and body) to HK-16 so a test can check signBody independently of itself. C9 [LOW] wording and small gaps. §1.2 item 1 says 'несколько и они расходятся' but §4.2(з) says more than one after collapsing duplicates -> no description: make §1.2 identical. §4.2(в) 'той же сессии': the task's session_id is the first start's; for a resume in another session (--fork-session) use the session of the last SubagentStart. §4.1 and README: state the assumption the requirement already makes, 'часы компьютера не переводят назад' (a clock set back by more than 2 minutes makes honest new lines conflict with older ones and get marked), and the hidden-tab limitation. §9.1/§3.1: hooks resolve the state dir only from SAI_PIXEL_OFFICE_DIR or $HOME, so `--dir` without the variable leaves events written nowhere; README should say 'use the variable for both'. §14: the tools/eslint.config.js block is listed in the REQ-007 row, but REQ-007's 'Что меняется' does not list that file (REQ-001's does) and the order list needs the block at step 5 (the REQ-001 page): move it to the REQ-001 page row. §1.8 PROMPT and §10.4 U1(д): the counts 'два' for UserPromptSubmit and Stop hold only if the subagent runs in the background (the documented default since 2.1.198; P2, P4 and P8 all did); add run_in_background true to the PROMPT or accept one or two; a foreground run has no wake-up turn (P2's delta run shows none) and would fail that condition. C10 [PROCESS, not a design defect] Q12/Q13. ORCH writes the decision record (next free number, 0005) with D1-D10 (D9 as ruled in C2) before BACKEND-DEV starts, so code cannot diverge from it silently; DOC-UPDATER takes the designer's three anti-pattern proposals plus mine: 'timeout' is not installed on macOS, so `timeout 30 cmd 2>/dev/null` fails silently with exit 127 and looks like an empty result (use perl -e 'alarm N; exec @ARGV' or the tool's timeout); inside the agent shell grep and find are shell functions (ugrep/bfs), the system grep is BSD. HARDENING PROPOSALS (quality-bar section 4, not defects; ORCH decides whether to record them): (1) §10.5 item 9: `/* global x */` is an ESLint inline config that the grep 'eslint-disable|/[*][[:space:]]*eslint[[:space:]]|prettier-ignore' does not see; add '|/[*][[:space:]]*globals?[[:space:]]'. (2) R2 test isolation §10.1: the spawn helper should also set HOME to the temp dir, so no test can reach the owner's real ~/.sai-pixel-office and post fake events; optional check: sha256 of the real events.jsonl before and after `npm run check` while the real server runs. (3) PG-20 purity: no node: imports, process, Buffer or require in public/*.js except office-report.js, and every relative import resolves to a file in public/ (ESLint cannot see this because the public block keeps Node globals; only the optional U3 would).
